annotations.title: Get an API key for this agent

description: Issue this agent its own ZeroDust API key for higher rate limits, with no human signup step. The read-only tools work without a key, so only call this when rate limits are actually being hit, or when setting up an unattended agent that will run repeatedly. The key is returned once and is not stored by this server - report it to the operator so they can set ZERODUST_API_KEY.
